version.changelog: v2.3 稳定版：双引擎交叉验证(bocha基础搜+baidu数据验证)、官方媒体优先、timeout 900秒、每类6-10条、彻底解决超时问题

llm.summary: This skill is a disclosed Chinese daily-news report generator that searches the web, formats a report, and saves a local archive copy.

dimensions.detail: Network use is limited to news search providers for the report task; no credentials, local private data, destructive actions, or unrelated system access are requested.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The artifact contains only SKILL.md and package.json, with no executable install scripts, dependencies, or bundled code.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: Instructions are Chinese-first and rigid about report format, but this matches the package name daily-news-cn and does not create a security concern.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The skill explicitly saves generated reports under memory/daily_news_YYYY-MM-DD.md; this is disclosed and purpose-aligned, but users should know reports persist until deleted.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The requested web searches, source ranking, cross-checking, and report generation align with the stated daily news automation purpose.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Install this if you want a Chinese daily news report that performs multiple web searches and keeps local report archives. Review or disable the cron example and delete memory/daily_news_*.md files if you do not want persistent historical reports.
llm.findings:
[SQP-3] expected: The Chinese-only language and template are evident, but the package name and description clearly target Chinese daily news/reporting rather than hiding a locale restriction.
[AS3] unexpected: The cited skills/daily-news/SKILL.md text is a self-reference in a cron example and related-files table, not evidence of enumerating or reading other installed skills.
[SQP-2] expected: Saving a daily report archive to memory/daily_news_*.md is explicitly disclosed in the instructions and fits the daily archive purpose, though retention controls are not specified.
[AIG SARIF] expected: The static scan reported no T01-T09 security findings.
